I have completed the independent final audit of the completed F1 and F2 findings and reproducibility outputs and written the report to [argon_f12_final.txt](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reviews/darkmatter-family-analysis-20261015/argon_f12_final.txt) (`SHA-256: e8cc2006623bc2af9380190961c2b02140123981182efb6462d3f97b9a3f7013`). [main.tex](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/manuscript/main.tex) (`2fcc918baaf344de6ef96915b060e4b8ce0ee6fefa7a26168475766b281b0a8b`) and all analysis files remain untouched.

### Summary of Per-Hypothesis Verdicts & Reproducibility Audit

1. **Correction of Prior Report (`argon_results_initial.txt`)**:
   - Verified directly from [had_all.hmm](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reproducibility/darkmatter/family_discovery_20261015/f12/references_v2/had_all.hmm) that the F2 combined HMM database contains **only two profiles** (`PF00702.33` `Hydrolase` and `PF13419.13` `HAD_2`); my prior reference to `PF08282` and `PF13344` is withdrawn.
   - Verified ORIX `NVIDIA H200` execution on `orix-worker-h200-7` across [smoke_results_v3/slurm_execution.txt](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reproducibility/darkmatter/family_discovery_20261015/gpu/smoke_results_v3/slurm_execution.txt) (jobs `316812` & `316813`), [smoke_results_v4/provenance.json](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reproducibility/darkmatter/family_discovery_20261015/gpu/smoke_results_v4/provenance.json), and production F1 embeddings ([f1_embeddings/slurm_execution.txt](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reproducibility/darkmatter/family_discovery_20261015/root_audit/f1_embeddings/slurm_execution.txt) & [verification_report.json](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reproducibility/darkmatter/family_discovery_20261015/root_audit/f1_embeddings/verification_report.json), job `316862`).

2. **F1 Core Census, Complete-Gene Harmonization & SPL Sensitivity ([f1_full/summary.json](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reproducibility/darkmatter/family_discovery_20261015/root_audit/f1_full/summary.json), [f1_complete_panel/summary.json](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reproducibility/darkmatter/family_discovery_20261015/root_audit/f1_complete_panel/summary.json), [f1_spl_sensitivity/summary.json](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reproducibility/darkmatter/family_discovery_20261015/root_audit/f1_spl_sensitivity/summary.json), [f1_final_audit/audit.json](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reproducibility/darkmatter/family_discovery_20261015/root_audit/f1_final_audit/audit.json))**:
   - **Decision**: **PARTIAL / CONDITIONAL SUPPORT** | **Reproducibility**: **PASS WITH DOCUMENTED SENSITIVITY LIMITATION** | **Fit for Paper**: **Include as descriptive/comparative support (not a novel-family breakthrough)**.
   - Across `5,438` `Wdb` MAGs (`20,451,986` proteins), the core 3-profile CPF screen (`PF00875`, `PF03441`, `PF04244`, `iE <= 1e-5`, `cov >= 0.70`) recovers **`1,154` candidates** across **`935` carrier MAGs (`17.19%`)**, including **`914` complete (`partial=00`) genes** across **`775` complete-carrier MAGs (`14.25%`)**.
   - In the harmonized complete-gene panel ([f1_complete_panel/summary.json](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reproducibility/darkmatter/family_discovery_20261015/root_audit/f1_complete_panel/summary.json), job `53817327`: `914` EQ, `398` complete SMAG out of `503`, `1,079` complete GEM out of `1,192`, `59` curated refs, with 100% coordinate/hash closure across all `1,695` environmental comparator rows), bidirectional coverage-passing (`>= 0.70`) closest hits for the `914` complete EQ queries are **`883/914` (`43.8%` median identity, `652` `<50%`) vs curated references**, **`903/914` (`55.8%` median) vs complete SMAG**, and **`904/914` (`57.75%` median) vs complete GEM**.
   - Because the known positive control `QCI56913.1` (`MK474076`; Xu et al. 2021, `doi:10.1093/molbev/msab191`) fails the `>= 0.70` profile coverage gate (`PF03441` cov `64/203` despite `iE = 1.3e-9`) and a standalone `--ultra-sensitive` DIAMOND search ([passing.tsv](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reproducibility/darkmatter/family_discovery_20261015/root_audit/f1_spl_sensitivity/passing.tsv), job `53817185`) recovers `3` coverage-passing EQ homologs (`2` outside the profile census: `54PRr2_1415427_46` at `59.6%` pident and `F25Sr1_2259281_5` at `27.1%` pident), the core profile census must be presented as non-exhaustive across short/divergent SPL-like subfamilies.

3. **F1 Comparative Phylogenetic Breadth & High-Dimensional Embedding Dispersion ([f1_phylogeny/summary.json](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reproducibility/darkmatter/family_discovery_20261015/root_audit/f1_phylogeny/summary.json), [f1_final_audit/audit.json](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reproducibility/darkmatter/family_discovery_20261015/root_audit/f1_final_audit/audit.json), [f1_plots/distances.tsv](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reproducibility/darkmatter/family_discovery_20261015/root_audit/f1_plots/distances.tsv))**:
   - **Decision**: **NOT ESTABLISHED / REJECT EXCEPTIONAL EQ BREADTH OR NOVELTY CLAIM** | **Reproducibility**: **PASS**.
   - Equal-size (`n = 200`, 100 seeds) reference-conditioned added branch length on fixed joint FastTree domain trees ([f1_final_audit/audit.json](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reproducibility/darkmatter/family_discovery_20261015/root_audit/f1_final_audit/audit.json#L32-L101)) is lower in EQ than in global GEM both before and after excluding partial fragments: **`PF00875` complete-only mean `EQ = 113.26` (`95%` draw range `107.13..118.56`) vs `SMAG = 114.62` vs `GEM = 138.00` (`131.20..145.13`)**; **`PF03441` complete-only mean `EQ = 80.31` (`75.54..85.10`) vs `SMAG = 83.09` vs `GEM = 98.65` (`91.38..106.64`)**.
   - In 1024-d ProstT5 space ([distances.tsv](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reproducibility/darkmatter/family_discovery_20261015/root_audit/f1_plots/distances.tsv), job `53817033`; complete-only plot job `53818392` is noted as not yet materialized on disk), median nearest-reference cosine distance is **`EQ = 0.011968`** vs **`GEM = 0.014073`** (`0.013141` complete-only) and **`SMAG = 0.013507`** (`0.011408` complete-only).

4. **F1 Ecological Light-Niche Partitioning ([f1_compartment_tests.tsv](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reproducibility/darkmatter/family_discovery_20261015/ecology/results_root_v3/f1_compartment_tests.tsv), [f1_ecology_provenance.json](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reproducibility/darkmatter/family_discovery_20261015/ecology/results_root_v3/f1_ecology_provenance.json), [within_phylum_multiplicity.tsv](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reproducibility/darkmatter/family_discovery_20261015/root_audit/f1_final_audit/within_phylum_multiplicity.tsv))**:
   - **Decision**: **PARTIAL SUPPORT** (Primary `cpf_complete` supported; `cpf_complete_exclusive` beyond `K01669` **INCONCLUSIVE / NULL**).
   - Across `550` non-zero-mapped sample profiles (`551` considered; `F5Dr1` excluded with zero mapped reads) forming **`37` strictly paired sites (`69` site-trip visits)**, primary `cpf_complete` (`775` MAGs) shows a **paired median Surface $-$ Deep difference of `+8.4726` percentage points** (`95%` CI `[+2.2993, +13.5544]`, Wilcoxon $p = 2.3364 \times 10^{-4}$, Holm $p = 0.0019587$).
   - However, **`cpf_complete_exclusive` (complete CPF carriers lacking `K01669`) is null**: **$\Delta = +0.0045$ percentage points, `95%` CI `[-0.0149, +0.0447]`, Wilcoxon $p = 0.53261$** (`occurrence_pct` $p = 0.13109$). Across all 21 within-phylum tests ([within_phylum_multiplicity.tsv](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reproducibility/darkmatter/family_discovery_20261015/root_audit/f1_final_audit/within_phylum_multiplicity.tsv)), only `Actinomycetota` ($\Delta = +3.215\%$, $p_{\text{Holm,all21}} = 0.0066946$) survives Holm correction for `cpf_complete` (`Pseudomonadota` $p_{\text{Holm,all21}} = 0.0824908$). The phrase `"indicates ecological selection"` in [f1_ecology_provenance.json](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reproducibility/darkmatter/family_discovery_20261015/ecology/results_root_v3/f1_ecology_provenance.json#L55) is rejected in favor of **association only**.

5. **F2 Historical Compatible-Solute Phosphatase Leads ([f2_identity/summary.json](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reproducibility/darkmatter/family_discovery_20261015/root_audit/f2_identity/summary.json), [identity_records.json](file:///home/leechuck/Documents/papers/empty-quarter-mags/reproducibility/darkmatter/family_discovery_20261015/root_audit/f2_identity/identity_records.json))**:
   - **Decision**: **NOT ESTABLISHED / REJECT SPECIFIC PHOSPHATASE ASSIGNMENT (STOP CONFIRMED)** | **Reproducibility**: **PASS**. Both verified `partial=00` `Thermoplasmatota` proteins (`93 aa` and `148 aa`) have `0` HMM hits (`PF00702`, `PF13419`) and `0` `--ultra-sensitive` DIAMOND hits (`e <= 1e-3`).
